Ruling: batch #430 item 2 · letter A+ · maintainer 「所以我说评估标准对象的意思，就是允许放开的动作，是不是就应该把申明加上」 2026-10-30T12:40Z

Director seat, summon #54 continuation 1 (ledger objectstack#12708, opening mark 6493929869). In the summon chat the maintainer first asked what A would build (「从业务的角度给我具体解释你要开发什么」), struck the pin test (「自动检查 有必要吗？每一个元数据应用都有类似的问题，后续都要检查吗」 — the seat agreed: a repo-local test guards nothing in customer apps; the platform's own mechanisms are the per-action opt-in, the default confirmation and the ADR-0126 activation switch), then settled the shape, verbatim: 「所以我说评估标准对象的意思，就是允许放开的动作，是不是就应该把申明加上」. The seat reads that as **A+** and records it so; the maintainer corrects with one word if the reading is wrong.

**What the ruling binds (letter A+):** the three-bucket assessment of the 58 `sys_*` actions in this card's body stands, and the declarations are written now, in one PR:
- **E (22, exposable by plain declaration)** — each action gets `ai: { exposed: true, description: … }` (a description written for the model, ≥ 40 chars per ADR-0011); confirmation at the author's choice.
- **C (17, exposable with confirmation)** — each action gets `ai: { exposed: true, description: …, requiresConfirmation: true }`; the confirmation is never relaxed.
- **H (19, human-only)** — no `ai` block; the dated note under ADR-0011 records the list and the rule: no `ai.exposed` on these without a maintainer ruling naming the action.
- **No automatic check.** The table lives only as the ADR-0011 dated note; reviewers of `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/**` read it. Customer apps govern their own actions with the same metadata key and the platform's defaults (opt-in, default confirmation, the ADR-0126 switch); the platform checks nothing per app.
Not taken: A (table only, no declarations), B (all human-only), C (E only).

Governing text: ADR-0011 (opt-in, `ai.description`, confirmation parity); ADR-0066 D4 as amended (one gate, two surfaces); #27681 ruling 6513869839 with amendment 6513938013 (parameter 2 executed here); ADR-0126 (the operator's switch, unchanged).

**Workload of the letter:** `domain:server` · 1 PR · M (39 `ai` blocks with model-facing descriptions across the 12 identity object files; the ADR-0011 dated note — `docs/adr/**`, Tier H, so the PR is Tier H and waits for an authorised approval after contract review; one dogfood case per bucket over MCP: an E action listed and run, a C action refused until confirmed, an H action absent from the listing) · `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` (values on an existing key, platform-owned metadata) · precedent: none for a platform-wide declaration pass.

**Execution:** `needs-user-decision` → `pm:blocked` in this act, `Blocked-by: #27681` (the door mechanism; the declarations are inert until both guards yield to the flag, and the dogfood cases need the door), `domain:server`, `priority:p1` (inherited from #27681 / #27506). When #27681 closes, the unlock scan returns this card to `pm:queue` and the server lane dispatches with `Ruling-ref:` naming this comment.

os-decision-facets
① 长远：评估结果直接落为元数据声明，门一通 AI 助手当天可用；H 档只靠 ADR 注记与评审，平台不逐应用检查
② 拉动：维护者设计目标；39 个动作一次声明到位，不再逐卡
③ 防错：C 档写死确认；H 档零声明；客户应用靠平台默认关闭与默认确认
④ 不扩散：不加键、不加门禁、不加检查；只写既有键的值

domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS

Note for whichever PR carries this card's `sys_*` declarations. It comes from the contract review of PR #28119 (#27694 / #27956), should-fix 1. ⛔ Not a claim.

PR #28119 adds a dated note (2026-10-30) under ADR-0066 D4's 2026-10-29 amendment. The note records that PR #27940 closed the `sys_*` MCP gap: an action on a `sys_*` object is listed and run over MCP only when the action itself declares `ai.exposed: true`, and the stored-metadata family is refused before the flag is read. At `bc496bf7d`, **zero** platform `sys_*` actions declare an `ai` block (ruling parameter 2, amendment 6513938013). So the mechanism exists, but no identity action is reachable over MCP yet.

When this card's declarations land, the carrier PR should keep ADR-0011's dated note and ADR-0066 D4's 2026-10-30 note consistent. It can point one at the other, or add a clause recording which `sys_*` actions now declare `ai.exposed: true`. Then the mechanism sentence is not read as "identity actions reachable over MCP from day one".

Blocker #27681 closed at 2026-10-30T10:36Z (PR #27940). The maintainer ruled **A+** (Ruling-ref 6523087116). `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue`. ⛔ Not a claim.

Ruling-ref: 6523087116 (letter A+: declarations for buckets E and C, H human-only, the ADR-0011 dated note, no automatic check; Tier H because of `docs/adr/**`)

**Dispatch note (carried into any claim):**
- All 39 E and C actions are `type: 'api'` with identity (better-auth) targets. Measured on `main` (#28178, #28217): such a target accepts a signed-in session only, so an OAuth agent's or an API-key caller's run of one does not reach it. An API-key caller is now refused by name before the forward (#28217, PR #28263).
- The dogfood case "an E action listed and run over MCP" is driven by an **OAuth agent**, not a session bearer, because that is the caller this ruling exposes the actions to. Its answer is pinned as it is on `main` at the time.
- ⛔ The card does **not** make that run succeed by changing which credentials an identity route or the REST face accepts, or by minting a session. That boundary is governed by the pending #28178 ruling. If the ruled behaviour cannot be shown without it, the PR lands the declarations and the ADR note, and the run case waits on #28178.
